svg.title: Date Picker spacing
svg.desc: The popup enters, then September changes to October with the native caption and week-grid slide and fade. An open desktop date picker with October 19, 2026 selected. The trigger and panel are 252 pixels wide. The trigger is 34 pixels high and the panel is 304 pixels high for this five-week month, including the Today footer. Blue dashed guides show the 6 pixel calendar inset, 34 pixel day cells, 3 pixel week gaps, and the 30 pixel selection inset by 2 pixels.
